purpose: Systematic, pre-specified task statements for BugsInPy tasks, replacing the old project's hand paraphrases.
source_priority: Issue(s) the fix explicitly closes: closing keyword (fix/close/resolve #N) in the fixed-commit message, or in the title/body of the PR that the commit message references or that GitHub lists for the fixed commit.
Otherwise a sole plain #N reference in the fixed-commit message that resolves to an issue (not a PR).
ineligible: No linked issue (PR descriptions and commit messages describe the fix and are never used as statements).
Issue body contains any added line (>=20 chars, stripped) of the reference fix diff verbatim (solution leakage).
Combined statement longer than 8000 characters (recorded, not truncated).
composition: For each linked issue in ascending number: 'Issue title' line + body verbatim; HTML comments removed; nothing else added. A fixed common wrapper sentence identical for all tasks and arms.
notes: Issue text is a user report, as in SWE-bench; it can be vague or under-specified, which is realistic and equal across memory arms.
Eligibility is decided from provenance and environment controls only; never from model outcomes.
